key_observation: Baseline LLM relies solely on parametric knowledge with no external retrieval. Faithfulness of 0.69 and answer relevance of 0.74, but hallucination rate of 0.31 shows the model occasionally generates ungrounded content.

Dense semantic retrieval via ChromaDB. Faithfulness +32% vs baseline (0.69 → 0.91). Hallucination drops -71% (0.31 → 0.09). Grounding answers in retrieved evidence substantially improves trustworthiness.

BM25 keyword-based retrieval with no embedding model. Faithfulness +20% vs baseline (0.69 → 0.83). Hallucination rate: 0.17. Keyword matching captures exact medical terminology but misses semantic similarity.

Hybrid retrieval merges dense and BM25 rankings via Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Faithfulness +33% vs baseline (0.69 → 0.92). Hallucination rate: 0.08. Combining both retrieval signals improves coverage over either approach alone.
